description:
[Game reference] Everything at one monument in one call. The monument (`tier`, safe zone, radiation, recyclers, tunnel entrance...) with `loot_sources` (crates and NPC
loot tables), `placements` (recyclers with efficiency, NPC shops, CCTV camera ids, crates and their spawn points),
`vending` (each shop's offers - what it sells and for what), `cctv_codes` (the Computer Station codes), `puzzle`
(keycard/fuse doors in order, resets, radiation and puzzle loot - null when it has none), `missions` (NPC
missions given here with rewards) and `design_notes`. Follow up with `/loot-tables/{id}` for odds. Everything at one monument in one call (loot, recyclers, shops, CCTV, puzzle, missions).
name: get_monument_full
title: Everything at one monument in one call
